summary: Regression test after console.error additions in NotesPanel.load() and AdaptiveQuiz.next() rank-up check. All 11 backend endpoint tests pass. Frontend end-to-end verified: student/teacher/parent/admin logins all render their dashboards; chapter viewer opens; My Notes tab clicks trigger GET /api/notes and render the panel with no UI hang; adaptive quiz flow (Take Quiz Now -> select option -> Confirm Answer -> feedback panel -> Next Question) works and advances from Q1 to Q2 without errors. No unhandled console errors observed (only a benign Recharts width/height warning on a hidden chart).

issues: Recharts warning: chart container width/height = -1 on a hidden chart (Study Activity or similar). Non-blocking, but should set explicit dimensions or aspect ratio to silence.

critical_code_review_comments: The console.error additions in NotesPanel.jsx (line 34) and AdaptiveQuiz.jsx (line 92) are correct and purely additive — no regression.
Minor: hidden Recharts container triggers a width/height=-1 warning on the student dashboard; fix by ensuring the parent has non-zero height or use a fixed aspect prop.
seed_data_creation: None. Used pre-seeded chapters (Ch 10 Light – Reflection and Refraction, etc.).
